Dashboard.Title: Repository Diagnostics
Dashboard.Subtitle: Inspect registered DbContexts, connection health, database activity, and EF Core migrations.

Messages.LoadingContextsDescription: Reading Repository registrations, connection status, and migration metadata.
Messages.NoContextsDescription: Register a Repository DbContext to unlock database diagnostics.

Overview.Empty: Select a DbContext to inspect its runtime details.

Pool.Title: Connection Pool
Pool.SessionsNote: Session counts come from the provider activity view (pg_stat_activity) and include every client connected to this database, not only this application's pool.
Pool.SessionsUnavailable: Session statistics are unavailable because the provider activity query is unsupported or has not been loaded yet.

Options.Empty: No displayable Repository options were found for this DbContext.

Activity.NoRows: No active sessions were returned by the provider.
Activity.NoMatches: No sessions match the current filters.

Controls.SearchPlaceholder: Search user, client, application, state, or query

Guide.Title: Manual Activity Query
Guide.UnsupportedDescription: Repository does not have a built-in activity SQL template for this EF Core provider yet. Use the provider's own session, process, or activity catalog views.
Guide.UsageDescription: Run this read-only SQL against the same database used by the selected DbContext when you want to inspect activity outside the dashboard.
Guide.SourceDescription: Repository reads provider activity from {0} and normalizes the rows for the dashboard.
Guide.CopyFailed: Clipboard copy failed. Select the SQL text manually.

PostgreSql.Description: PostgreSQL activity diagnostics read pg_stat_activity, including session runtime, state, client, application, user, lock waiting state, and current query text.
PostgreSql.Source: The Waiting value is derived from PostgreSQL lock wait event metadata.

OpenGauss.Description: openGauss-compatible activity diagnostics read pg_stat_activity, including session runtime, state, client, application, user, waiting state, resource pool, query id, and trace fields when exposed by the provider.
OpenGauss.Source: The query uses openGauss-compatible pg_stat_activity columns and also works for compatible providers that expose the same activity catalog.

Columns.Runtime: Elapsed time since the current query started.
Columns.ApplicationName: Application name reported by the client connection.
Columns.Waiting: Whether the session is waiting for a resource or lock.
Columns.Query: Current or most recent SQL text.
Columns.BackendStart: Time when the backend process started.
Columns.XactStart: Time when the current transaction started.
Columns.QueryStart: Time when the current query started.
Columns.StateChange: Time when the session state last changed.

Migrations.Title: Migration Management
Migrations.Subtitle: Review migration inventory and apply pending migrations for selected or all contexts.
Migrations.DisabledInProduction: Migration updates are disabled in Production unless explicitly enabled in module options.
Migrations.ContextNote: Counts are scoped to migration assembly {0}. External history rows are already recorded in the database but are not part of this DbContext's current migration assembly.

Lists.CurrentAssemblyDescription: Every migration known by the selected DbContext, marked by its database state.
Lists.ExternalAppliedDescription: Rows found in the database history table but not in the selected migration assembly.

Confirm.AllMessage: Apply {0} pending migrations across all registered DbContexts.
